general_information.name: I THINK IT’S JAMES CAMPBELL — OR THAT’S THE NAME I USUALLY GO BY. DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY ID, OR JUST MY FULL NAME?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve been floundering at work — like I can’t really get moving on a simple project. I’m having a hard time concentrating, and I don’t really have much sense of where things are going.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to function better at work and, I guess, move forward again.
